items.headline: Taylor throws for 354 yards and 4 TDs, Mississippi State routs Louisiana-Monroe 62-13
items.description: — Kamario Taylor passed for 354 yards and four touchdowns, added 59 yards and a score on the ground, and Mississippi State cruised past Louisiana-Monroe 62-13 in the season opener for both teams on Saturday.

items.headline: MS State's Kamario Taylor dissects his long and short-term preparation
items.description: Taylor takes time to discuss the offseason habits that have helped him become a better leader and physically ready for anything.
